newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Feb 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Feb 11.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
LONDON PRIEST IS STABBED AT CHURCH
Father Edward Carroll, a parish priest from Holloway, London was today in intensive care after being stabbed in the back at his rectory yesterday.
PRIVATISATION STUDY GIVES TORIES A BOOST

Tonight in Westminster Chancellor Kenneth Clarke will give a speech based on a report by independent research group National Economic Research Association. In his pre-general election speech he will claim that following privatisations there are sharp cuts in prices and great increases in quality of service from companies.

According to the latest survey by Taskforce 2000, the situation is now "desperate' with regard to the dangers of computers crashing because they will not recognise the century change in the year 2000.
DE BEERS TAKES SHINE OFF TALK OF GEMS DEAL

Yesterday the De Beers Corporation dismissed reports that it had reached agreement with Russia over a long awaited diamond purchase accord. This followed news that a Russian minister had leaked reports of a 'compromise deal' being made during weekend discussions.
From today the latest research on 365 investment trusts researched by Natwest will be available via the Internet. The information will be available free and it will be constantly updated.
